description: Mid reviewer finds event emitter leak and provides good pushback. Solid mid-level with strong communication.

prContext.title: Add real-time notification service
prContext.description: EventEmitter-based service for candidate status notifications.
prContext.instructions: Review for memory safety and event handling.

groundTruth.description: EventEmitter.on adds listener but there is no cleanup when component unmounts — leaked listeners accumulate, causing memory growth and duplicate event handling.
unsubscribe does not check if the set becomes empty — empty Sets remain in the Map, causing memory leak over time.
handler typed as Function and cast as any — loses type safety. Should use generic or specific event type.
Singleton export — hard to test and mock. Should use factory or DI.

reviewer_comments.what: Listeners are never cleaned up on unmount. Need a way to auto-unsubscribe.
reviewer_comments.why: Leaked event listeners cause memory growth and duplicate handling.

reviewer_comments.what: unsubscribe leaves empty Sets in the Map.
reviewer_comments.why: Empty sets still consume memory and the Map grows unbounded.

reviewer_comments.what: handler should be typed, not Function.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Two blocking memory issues. Type suggestion is optional.

implementer_responses.content: Added unsubscribeAll method called on unmount.
implementer_responses.updated_code: unsubscribeAll(candidateId: string) { this.listeners.get(candidateId)?.forEach(h => this.off(candidateId, h as any)); this.listeners.delete(candidateId); }

implementer_responses.content: Function is sufficient for now. We will type events in a follow-up.

verdict.summary: Memory fixes look good. Function type is acceptable for now.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (leak, empty sets). Missed handler typing and singleton pattern. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: Both memory issues flagged as blocking. Type as suggestion. Good triage. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified unsubscribeAll and empty set cleanup. Held line on type pushback with reasoning. Level 3-4.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete memory rationales. Good technical depth. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested unsubscribeAll and set cleanup — actionable. Level 3-4.
